turns.utterance: Using a photoelectric sensor or stopwatch triggered from the solenoid valve signal, measure the elapsed time from blow off command to part clear of the cup. Record the release time and compare against the maximum permitted release time in the cycle specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Using a photoelectric sensor or a stopwatch triggered from the solenoid valve signal, measure the elapsed time from blow off command to part clear of the cup. Record the release time and compare against the maximum permitted release time in the cycle specification. Unusually long release times indicate cup face contamination or low blow off flow.

turns.speaker: operator
